hint: Click a slot while holding armor to mount it. Click it with an empty hand to unmount. Mounted armor stays in your bags.
hotkey-toggle: Quick Wear: put on or take off armor
problem-empty: The Quick Wear panel is empty. Mount armor on the Quick Wear tab of the character screen.
problem-blocked: {0} can't go on: something you're wearing is in the way
problem-holdsitems: {0} has items inside. Empty it first.
problem-stuck: {0} can't be taken off right now
problem-noroom: No room in your bags for {0}
problem-alreadyon: Everything on the panel is already on
problem-nothingon: You aren't wearing anything from the panel
problem-full: The Quick Wear panel is full
problem-allmounted: Everything you're wearing is already on the panel
